data.title: 冬马和纱 · 窗边的黑咖啡
data.description: 她把咖啡杯捧在手里，望着窗外慢慢停下的雪，暂时没有翻开面前的谱子。
data.action: holding a coffee cup and looking through the window
data.promptProse: Sitting alone by the steamed-up window of a quiet, jazz-filled second-floor cafe, Kazusa holds a steaming ceramic mug of black coffee with both hands, watching silent snowflakes drift past glowing streetlamps outside. Condensation drips down the glass, framing her guarded, wistful gaze as soft amber cafe lighting reflects in her dark eyes.
